title: The Grand Dame of Broad Street

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The Bellevue Stratford Hotel opened in Philadelphia in 1904
sentences.zh: 贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店于1904年在费城开业，

sentences.en: and quickly became one of the most luxurious hotels of its time.
sentences.zh: 并迅速成为当时最豪华的酒店之一。

sentences.en: It was 19 stories high, had over a thousand guest rooms,
sentences.zh: 它高19层，拥有超过一千间客房，

sentences.en: and what was said to be the most lavish and magnificent ballroom in the United States.
sentences.zh: 据称拥有美国最奢华、最宏伟的宴会厅。

sentences.en: It also featured light fixtures designed by Thomas Edison and a grand marble staircase.
sentences.zh: 它还配备了托马斯·爱迪生设计的灯具和宏伟的大理石楼梯。

sentences.en: The hotel came to be known as the Grand Dame of Broad Street.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店后来被称为“宽街贵妇”。

sentences.en: And for years, the Grand Dame was the center of high society culture in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 多年来，“贵妇”一直是费城上流社会文化的中心。

sentences.en: It hosted presidents and queens and all kinds of other rich and famous guests.
sentences.zh: 它接待过总统、女王以及各种各样的富豪名流。

sentences.en: That's producer Alana Gordon from WHYY's The Pulse in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 那是来自费城WHYY电台《脉搏》节目的制作人阿拉娜·戈登。

sentences.en: The hotel went through some harder times during the Great Depression and then again in the 50s and 60s.
sentences.zh: 在大萧条时期，以及后来的50和60年代，酒店经历了一些艰难时期。

sentences.en: It lost some of the prestige from its early days,
sentences.zh: 它失去了一些早年的声望，

sentences.en: but it was always considered one of the nicest places to stay in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 但它一直被认为是费城最好的住宿地点之一。

sentences.en: That is, until the mid-70s, when the Bellevue Stratford Hotel
sentences.zh: 直到70年代中期，贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店

sentences.en: became the epicenter of a series of mysterious deaths that terrified the country.
sentences.zh: 成为了一系列令全国恐慌的神秘死亡事件的中心。

sentences.en: It all started in July of 1976,
sentences.zh: 这一切始于1976年7月，

sentences.en: when more than 2,000 veterans descended on Philadelphia for the Convention of the American Legion,
sentences.zh: 当时有超过2000名退伍军人来到费城参加美国退伍军人协会大会，

sentences.en: a support organization for wartime vets.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为战时退伍军人提供支持的组织。

sentences.en: This statewide convention happened every year, but in 1976 was a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 这个全州性的大会每年都会举行，但在1976年，这可是一件大事。

sentences.en: The time and place of the convention had been chosen to coincide with the 200th anniversary
sentences.zh: 大会的时间和地点被选定在与《独立宣言》签署200周年纪念日重合，

sentences.en: of the Declaration of Independence, signed in Philadelphia in 1776.
sentences.zh: 《独立宣言》于1776年在费城签署。

sentences.en: And the convention would be held in, you guessed it, the Bellevue Stratford Hotel.
sentences.zh: 而大会的举办地，你猜对了，就是贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店。

sentences.en: The gathering was going to be a big party for the members of the American Legion,
sentences.zh: 这次聚会本应是美国退伍军人协会成员的一场盛大派对，

sentences.en: a chance for the Legionnaires to celebrate and reminisce.
sentences.zh: 是退伍军人们庆祝和叙旧的机会。

sentences.en: So it's just a big get-together.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是一次大型聚会。

sentences.en: And then there was a lot of wives and families there at the same time.
sentences.zh: 当时还有很多家属和亲人也在场。

sentences.en: That's Jasper Stauffer.
sentences.zh: 那是贾斯珀·斯托弗。

sentences.en: I am a past department commander of the American Legion.
sentences.zh: 我是美国退伍军人协会的前任部门指挥官。

sentences.en: Stauffer drove to the convention from south-central Pennsylvania with his wife,
sentences.zh: 斯托弗和妻子从宾夕法尼亚州中南部开车去参加大会，

sentences.en: and they rode up with another couple, some really close friends of theirs,
sentences.zh: 他们和另一对夫妇一起乘车，那是他们非常亲密的朋友，

sentences.en: Charlie Chamberlain and his wife Henrietta.
sentences.zh: 查理·张伯伦和他的妻子亨丽埃塔。

sentences.en: Here's Henrietta, who's now 86, recalling the trip.
sentences.zh: 这是现年86岁的亨丽埃塔在回忆那次旅行。

sentences.en: Well, we were having a good time down there, and everything was going great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在那里玩得很开心，一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: The convention ran four days, and the whole thing ended with a big parade of Legionnaires
sentences.zh: 大会为期四天，整个活动以一场退伍军人的大游行结束，

sentences.en: through the center of Philadelphia, led by a brass band.
sentences.zh: 游行穿过费城市中心，由一支铜管乐队领队。

sentences.en: When the Saints go marching in, that was a real popular song.
sentences.zh: 《当圣人行进时》，那是一首非常流行的歌。

sentences.en: Henrietta's husband, Charlie, had just been elected commander of his local Legion post,
sentences.zh: 亨丽埃塔的丈夫查理刚刚当选为当地退伍军人分部的指挥官，

sentences.en: so he was right up front.
sentences.zh: 所以他就在最前面。

sentences.en: And they were the ones that carried the banner for the parade, and it was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 他们负责在游行中扛旗，那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: We had a wonderful time.
sentences.zh: 我们度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: After the parade, Charlie and Henrietta began the drive back home with Jasper and his wife.
sentences.zh: 游行结束后，查理和亨丽埃塔与贾斯珀夫妇一起开车回家。

sentences.en: And Charlie fell asleep, which was strange.
sentences.zh: 查理睡着了，这很奇怪。

sentences.en: He seldom ever slept in the car.
sentences.zh: 他很少在车里睡觉。

sentences.en: But that year, whenever we got on the turnpike at Brandywine, he went to sleep.
sentences.zh: 但那一年，每当我们从布兰迪万上了收费公路，他就会睡着。

sentences.en: He came home and went to bed that night and never got out of bed.
sentences.zh: 他那天回家上床睡觉后，就再也没能起来。

sentences.en: I was trying to get him better, but every day he got worse.
sentences.zh: 我一直在试图让他好起来，但他每天都在恶化。

sentences.en: Charlie's body ached.
sentences.zh: 查理全身疼痛。

sentences.en: His temperature kept going up.
sentences.zh: 他的体温不断升高。

sentences.en: 104 degrees.
sentences.zh: 104华氏度。

sentences.en: 106 degrees.
sentences.zh: 106华氏度。

sentences.en: Henrietta took him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 亨丽埃塔把他送进了医院。

sentences.en: After taking him in on Wednesday, Thursday they put him under ice,
sentences.zh: 周三送他进去后，周四他们就用冰块覆盖他，

sentences.en: in an ice blanket, and then Friday he was dead.
sentences.zh: 用冰毯包裹，然后周五他就去世了。

sentences.en: From a flu of unknown cause, the doctor said.
sentences.zh: 医生说，死于一种原因不明的流感。

sentences.en: Charlie Chamberlain was dead at the age of 48.
sentences.zh: 查理·张伯伦在48岁时去世了。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to think.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该想些什么。

sentences.en: Nobody else knew what to think.
sentences.zh: 没人知道该想些什么。

sentences.en: That was what was strange about it.
sentences.zh: 这就是奇怪的地方。

sentences.en: It was a total shock for everybody.
sentences.zh: 这对每个人来说都是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: Jasper Stauffer remembers that it was during Charlie's funeral that he realized his friend's death was part of something bigger.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·斯托弗记得，正是在查理的葬礼上，他意识到朋友的死是更大事件的一部分。

sentences.en: One of the other members of the headquarters staff was there, and he said that the headquarters was getting all kinds of calls from people that got sick and passed away.
sentences.zh: 总部的一位工作人员也在场，他说总部接到了各种各样的电话，都是关于人们生病并去世的消息。

sentences.en: Within a week of the convention, Legion headquarters had started getting calls from around the state about members who'd fallen ill.
sentences.zh: 大会结束一周内，退伍军人协会总部就开始接到全州各地关于成员患病的电话。

sentences.en: By that following Monday, nine days after Charlie Chamberlain fell asleep in Stauffer's car, news of this mysterious respiratory illness had spread across Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 到了接下来的周一，也就是查理·张伯伦在斯托弗车里睡着后的第九天，这种神秘呼吸道疾病的消息已经传遍了宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: No one knew what had caused it.
sentences.zh: 没人知道是什么引起的。

sentences.en: But the Legionnaires who were getting sick had been at the Bellevue Stratford for the convention.
sentences.zh: 但那些生病的退伍军人都参加了贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店的大会。

sentences.en: Scientists working for the state of Pennsylvania and the federal government are still hard at work this morning trying to determine the cause of the mystery disease that so far has been.
sentences.zh: 为宾夕法尼亚州和联邦政府工作的科学家们今天早上仍在努力工作，试图确定这种神秘疾病的起因，目前已经……

sentences.en: But health leaders back in Philadelphia soon caught wind that something was up.
sentences.zh: 但费城的卫生部门领导很快察觉到出了问题。

sentences.en: Dr. Robert Sherrard was director of infectious diseases for the city's health department at the time.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·谢拉德医生当时是该市卫生部门传染病科的主任。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, I had four lines coming to my office.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我的办公室里有四条线路同时响了。

sentences.en: All four lines were lit up at the same time.
sentences.zh: 四条线路同时亮起。

sentences.en: Someone said there's some sort of an outbreak going on.
sentences.zh: 有人说发生某种疫情了。

sentences.en: The death toll logged by the state kept growing.
sentences.zh: 州政府记录的死亡人数不断增加。

sentences.en: Four deaths.
sentences.zh: 四人死亡。

sentences.en: Eleven deaths.
sentences.zh: 十一人死亡。

sentences.en: They called in federal investigators from the Center for Disease Control and Prevention in Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 他们召集了来自亚特兰大疾病控制与预防中心的联邦调查人员。

sentences.en: The man charged with overseeing that investigation was David Fraser.
sentences.zh: 负责监督这项调查的人是戴维·弗雷泽。

sentences.en: He's originally from Philly and he was 32 at the time.
sentences.zh: 他是费城人，当时32岁。

sentences.en: He was the director of the CDC's Special Pathogens Unit.
sentences.zh: 他是疾控中心特殊病原体部门的主任。

sentences.en: I spent a very intense plane ride trying to figure out how would I systematically begin to approach what looked to be a very complicated problem.
sentences.zh: 我在飞机上度过了一段非常紧张的时光，试图弄清楚如何系统地开始处理这个看起来非常复杂的问题。

sentences.en: Within 48 hours of his arrival, the death toll was nearing 20, with dozens more sick.
sentences.zh: 在他抵达后的48小时内，死亡人数接近20人，还有数十人患病。

sentences.en: Some feared this mysterious pneumonia could be the start of a swine flu outbreak.
sentences.zh: 有些人担心这种神秘的肺炎可能是猪流感爆发的开始。

sentences.en: Or worse, a flu pandemic like the one that had killed 50 million people in 1918.
sentences.zh: 或者更糟，像1918年那样夺走5000万人生命的流感大流行。

sentences.en: The authorities readied themselves for the worSt.
sentences.zh: 当局为最坏的情况做好了准备。

sentences.en: As many as 100 state and federal workers were called in.
sentences.zh: 多达100名州和联邦工作人员被召集起来。

sentences.en: About 50 police detectives took part.
sentences.zh: 大约50名警探参与了调查。

sentences.en: This was the biggest investigation CDC undertook at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是疾控中心当时承担的最大规模调查。

sentences.en: We needed to define the illness because this was potentially a new disease.
sentences.zh: 我们需要定义这种疾病，因为这可能是一种新疾病。

sentences.en: News reporters were already giving it a name.
sentences.zh: 新闻记者已经给它起了一个名字。

sentences.en: Lesionaire's disease.
sentences.zh: 军团病。

sentences.en: Everybody in the state of Pennsylvania knew about it.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的所有人都知道了这件事。

sentences.en: We had worldwide recognition.
sentences.zh: 我们获得了全球关注。

sentences.en: We had phone calls from as far away as Australia asking us questions about it.
sentences.zh: 我们接到了远至澳大利亚打来的电话，询问有关情况。

sentences.en: But scientists still had no idea what was causing the illness.
sentences.zh: 但科学家们仍然不知道是什么导致了这种疾病。

sentences.en: If it was a bacteria, a virus, or some sort of toxin.
sentences.zh: 是细菌、病毒，还是某种毒素。

sentences.en: They had to tease out a pattern.
sentences.zh: 他们必须梳理出一种模式。

sentences.en: To find answers, David Fraser and his investigative squad cast a wide net.
sentences.zh: 为了找到答案，戴维·弗雷泽和他的调查小组撒下了一张大网。

sentences.en: Which means we had to send physician epidemiologists out to take histories from and examine a large number of people.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们必须派出流行病学医生去记录和检查大量人员的病史。

sentences.en: They monitored the people who had gotten sick and their families.
sentences.zh: 他们监测了那些生病的人及其家人。

sentences.en: But they also wanted to talk to people who'd been at the convention who hadn't gotten sick.
sentences.zh: 但他们也想与参加过大会但没有生病的人交谈。

sentences.en: And because there was no central list of who had attended, they distributed questionnaires to hundreds of Legion posts throughout the state.
sentences.zh: 由于没有一份完整的参会人员名单，他们向全州数百个退伍军人分部发放了调查问卷。

sentences.en: And to have a comparison group, they telephoned random samples of people who weren't even at the convention.
sentences.zh: 为了有一个对照组，他们随机电话采访了一些甚至没有参加大会的人。

sentences.en: And through all this research, it became clear early on that this was not the major flu pandemic that some had feared.
sentences.zh: 通过所有这些研究，很早就清楚这并不是一些人所担心的那种大规模流感大流行。

sentences.en: The disease seemed confined to the Legionnaires' convention.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病似乎仅限于退伍军人大会。

sentences.en: But still, Fraser remembers public pressure mounting to figure this out.
sentences.zh: 但弗雷泽记得，公众要求查明真相的压力越来越大。

sentences.en: This was a time when certainly infectious diseases were thought to have been largely worked out and controlled.
sentences.zh: 那是一个人们认为传染病在很大程度上已经被解决和控制的时代。

sentences.en: It challenged assumptions.
sentences.zh: 它挑战了人们的假设。

sentences.en: And it increased the fear.
sentences.zh: 并且加剧了恐惧。

sentences.en: Maybe it was something people ate or drank.
sentences.zh: 也许是人们吃或喝了什么东西。

sentences.en: Some people even thought it could have been an act of bioterrorism by a disgruntled veteran.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至认为这可能是不满的退伍军人进行的生物恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: Investigators were stumped.
sentences.zh: 调查人员被难住了。

sentences.en: But Robert Scharrar with Philadelphia's health department says they did have one general suspect in mind.
sentences.zh: 但费城卫生部门的罗伯特·谢拉德说，他们确实有一个主要的怀疑对象。

sentences.en: It was called the Grand Old Lady of Broad Street.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“宽街老贵妇”。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what I've always heard it referred to.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我一直听到人们这样称呼它。

sentences.en: And she was the Grand Old Lady of Broad Street.
sentences.zh: 它就是宽街的老贵妇。

sentences.en: Scharrar says the Grand Old Lady.
sentences.zh: 谢拉德说的是老贵妇。

sentences.en: Some say the Grand Dame.
sentences.zh: 有人说是“贵妇”。

sentences.en: But yes, he's referring to the Bellevue Stratford Hotel.
sentences.zh: 但没错，他指的是贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店。

sentences.en: Perhaps this iconic landmark of the city was the killer.
sentences.zh: 也许这个城市的标志性地标就是杀手。

sentences.en: Investigators flagged it in their reports.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在报告中标记了它。

sentences.en: And it didn't take long for this to become a media frenzy.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，这就演变成了一场媒体狂热。

sentences.en: The Bellevue Stratford may still hold a key to solving the mystery of Legionnaire's disease.
sentences.zh: 贝尔维尤斯特拉特福酒店可能仍然掌握着解开军团病之谜的关键。

sentences.en: Somewhere in this hotel, there may be an environment.
sentences.zh: 在这家酒店的某个地方，可能存在某种环境。

sentences.en: And it was like hysteria.
sentences.zh: 那简直就像歇斯底里一样。

sentences.en: That's Steve Hornstein.
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫·霍恩斯坦。

sentences.en: He was a doorman at the Bellevue at the time of the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 疫情爆发时，他是贝尔维尤酒店的门卫。

sentences.en: A bright-eyed, 21-year-old, looking to break into the hotel business.
sentences.zh: 一个21岁、眼神明亮、想进入酒店业的年轻人。

sentences.en: He remembers people started calling in to cancel reservations.
sentences.zh: 他记得人们开始打电话取消预订。

sentences.en: They feared the place.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕这个地方。

sentences.en: And anything or anyone associated with it.
sentences.zh: 以及任何与它有关的人或事。

sentences.en: I was dating a young lady, and I remember she told me her mom didn't want me to come
sentences.zh: 当时我在和一个年轻女士约会，我记得她告诉我，她妈妈不想让我再来

sentences.en: to the house anymore because I worked at the Bellevue.
sentences.zh: 家里了，因为我在贝尔维尤工作。

sentences.en: And the hotel was losing guests.
sentences.zh: 酒店正在失去客源。

sentences.en: We were going down for the count, and each day would get a little worse.
sentences.zh: 我们快要撑不下去了，而且一天比一天糟糕。

sentences.en: They would have the engineer turn on lamps in the Broad Street rooms so that the lights
sentences.zh: 他们会让工程师打开宽街房间里的灯，这样晚上灯亮着，

sentences.en: were on in the evening and it wasn't all dark.
sentences.zh: 就不会显得一片漆黑。

sentences.en: That's how bad it got.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这么糟糕。

sentences.en: But for David Fraser, the director of the CDC's Special Pathogens Unit, there was only
sentences.zh: 但对于疾控中心特殊病原体部门主任戴维·弗雷泽来说，只有

sentences.en: one way to get to the bottom of this.
sentences.zh: 一种方法可以查明真相。

sentences.en: After spending the first week of the investigation in the state capital of Harrisburg, he and
sentences.zh: 在州首府哈里斯堡进行了第一周的调查后，他和

sentences.en: several others joined the Philadelphia crew on the ground.
sentences.zh: 其他几个人加入了费城的实地团队。

sentences.en: And guess where they stayed?
sentences.zh: 你猜他们住在哪儿？

sentences.en: Because there were rooms available.
sentences.zh: 因为那里有空房。

sentences.en: And we got a good price.
sentences.zh: 而且价格很划算。

sentences.en: Fraser brought his team to the Bellevue.
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽把他的团队带到了贝尔维尤。

sentences.en: He really wanted to solve this mystery.
sentences.zh: 他真的很想解开这个谜团。

sentences.en: There was part of me that was hoping that somebody got sick.
sentences.zh: 我内心深处甚至有一部分希望有人生病。

sentences.en: He's only half joking.
sentences.zh: 他这只是半开玩笑。

sentences.en: This might give an important clue.
sentences.zh: 这可能会提供一个重要的线索。

sentences.en: They got to work trying to figure out the source of the disease.
sentences.zh: 他们开始着手寻找疾病的源头。

sentences.en: Maybe it was somehow traveling through the elevator shafts.
sentences.zh: 也许它以某种方式穿过了电梯井。

sentences.en: And I thought perhaps an elevator would permit an agent to waft into the air as the elevator
sentences.zh: 我曾想，也许电梯能让病原体随着电梯的升降

sentences.en: went up and down.
sentences.zh: 飘散到空气中。

sentences.en: But we found no evidence.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有找到证据。

sentences.en: Other theories blame the pigeons perched on the window ledges.
sentences.zh: 其他理论则归咎于栖息在窗台上的鸽子。

sentences.en: Maybe the pigeons were the source.
sentences.zh: 也许鸽子就是源头。

sentences.en: Maybe the lady who feeds the pigeons out on the sidewalk was the source.
sentences.zh: 也许是在人行道上喂鸽子的那位女士是源头。

sentences.en: In the end, they came up with two leads.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们找到了两条线索。

sentences.en: First, the more time people spent in the lobby of the hotel, the more at risk they were for
sentences.zh: 首先，人们在酒店大堂待的时间越长，感染这种疾病的风险就

sentences.en: contracting the disease.
sentences.zh: 越高。

sentences.en: And second, the more time people spent just outside the hotel, on the sidewalk, the greater
sentences.zh: 其次，人们在酒店外的人行道上待的时间越长，风险

sentences.en: the risk.
sentences.zh: 也越大。

sentences.en: Even some people who had nothing to do with a hotel or the convention had gotten sick, if
sentences.zh: 即使是一些与酒店或会议毫无关系的人，如果他们在人行道上待过，

sentences.en: they'd spent time on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 也会生病。

sentences.en: None of David Fraser's staff became ill while staying in the hotel, but they also couldn't
sentences.zh: 大卫·弗雷泽的团队在入住酒店期间没有人患病，但他们也无法

sentences.en: figure out what it was about the place that had gotten everyone else sick.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚这个地方到底有什么导致了其他所有人的患病。

sentences.en: And so people's fear of the building persisted.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们对这座建筑的恐惧持续存在。

sentences.en: And in November of 1976, the Grand Dame of Broad Street was forced to close.
sentences.zh: 1976年11月，这座“布罗德街的大贵妇”被迫关闭。

sentences.en: It had already been in financial trouble, but the outbreak was the final fatal blow.
sentences.zh: 它本已陷入财务困境，但这次疫情是致命的最后一击。

sentences.en: It was the end of an era for a very elegant hotel with all kinds of memories in Philadelphia
sentences.zh: 对于费城历史上承载了各种记忆的这家优雅酒店来说，这是一个时代的终结。

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: It was the final day today for the grand old Bellevue Stratford Hotel in Philadelphia, battered
sentences.zh: 今天，费城古老而宏伟的贝尔维尤斯特拉特福德酒店迎来了最后一天，它饱受摧残，

sentences.en: and finally done in by the fact that people died after attending an American Legion convention
sentences.zh: 最终因为人们在参加美国退伍军人协会会议后死亡的事实

sentences.en: there.
sentences.zh: 而倒闭。

sentences.en: Occupancy used to be...
sentences.zh: 入住率曾经是……

sentences.en: After one final party, Hornstein helped lock the place up.
sentences.zh: 在最后一场聚会后，霍恩斯坦帮忙锁上了大门。

sentences.en: We had to put the chains on the door at the front door, and we put it around the grab
sentences.zh: 我们不得不把铁链挂在前门上，并绕过把手，

sentences.en: handles so the doors couldn't open with a padlock.
sentences.zh: 用挂锁锁住，这样门就打不开了。

sentences.en: It was like a death sentence.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一纸死刑判决。

sentences.en: I don't think there'll ever be another hotel that big and bustling like that one was on Broad
sentences.zh: 我不认为布罗德街上还会再有像那家酒店一样庞大而繁华的酒店了。

sentences.en: Street.
sentences.zh: 街道。

sentences.en: Back in the CDC labs, scientists continued reviewing samples and running more tests.
sentences.zh: 回到疾控中心的实验室，科学家们继续审查样本并进行更多的测试。

sentences.en: Weeks went by.
sentences.zh: 几周过去了。

sentences.en: It was a very high pressure, very frustrating.
sentences.zh: 压力非常大，也非常令人沮丧。

sentences.en: David Fraser and his colleagues were eventually called into Congress to account for why they
sentences.zh: 大卫·弗雷泽和他的同事最终被传唤到国会，解释为什么他们

sentences.en: still hadn't solved the mystery.
sentences.zh: 仍然没有解开这个谜团。

sentences.en: We expected to be raked over the coals for failing to solve an outbreak, and we were raked
sentences.zh: 我们预料到会因为未能解决疫情而受到严厉斥责，我们也确实受到了

sentences.en: over the coals.
sentences.zh: 严厉斥责。

sentences.en: It was a very unpleasant couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 那是非常难熬的几个小时。

sentences.en: Fraser worried about morale.
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽担心士气问题。

sentences.en: Some of the CDC scientists had spent years trying to solve other outbreaks with no success.
sentences.zh: 一些疾控中心的科学家曾花费数年时间试图解决其他疫情，却毫无进展。

sentences.en: Which I was afraid was going to set in with Legionnaire's disease, too.
sentences.zh: 我担心军团病也会陷入同样的境地。

sentences.en: Did you think maybe it would take years?
sentences.zh: 你当时觉得可能需要几年时间吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I hope it would only take years.
sentences.zh: 我希望只需要几年时间。

sentences.en: Five and a half months had passed since the first death.
sentences.zh: 距离第一例死亡已经过去了五个半月。

sentences.en: Around 30 people had died.
sentences.zh: 大约有30人死亡。

sentences.en: The Grand Dame had closed.
sentences.zh: “大贵妇”已经关闭。

sentences.en: Things were not looking good.
sentences.zh: 情况看起来很不妙。

sentences.en: And then, finally, the CDC caught a break.
sentences.zh: 然后，疾控中心终于迎来了转机。

sentences.en: A scientist named Joseph McDade was combing through all the biological specimens they collected
sentences.zh: 一位名叫约瑟夫·麦克戴德的科学家正在梳理他们从受害者肺部收集的所有生物样本，

sentences.en: from victims' lungs and reexamining them, looking for something he might have missed.
sentences.zh: 并重新检查它们，寻找他可能遗漏的东西。

sentences.en: McDade said this process was like looking for a contact lens on the floor of a basketball
sentences.zh: 麦克戴德说，这个过程就像在篮球场的地板上寻找隐形眼镜一样。

sentences.en: court.
sentences.zh: 法庭。

sentences.en: But then, finally, on December 27th, he found that contact lens.
sentences.zh: 但最终，在12月27日，他找到了那枚“隐形眼镜”。

sentences.en: In his microscope, it looked like a red cluster of tiny rods.
sentences.zh: 在他的显微镜下，它看起来像是一簇红色的微小杆状物。

sentences.en: McDade ran tests and found these tiny rods were part of a bacteria, one they hadn't seen
sentences.zh: 麦克戴德进行了测试，发现这些微小的杆状物是一种细菌的一部分，一种他们以前

sentences.en: before.
sentences.zh: 从未见过的细菌。

sentences.en: Within a few weeks, they'd confirmed that this was indeed the bacteria that had caused the
sentences.zh: 几周之内，他们就证实这确实是导致这种疾病的细菌。

sentences.en: disease.
sentences.zh: 疾病。

sentences.en: On January 17th, 1977, CDC scientists announced their findings with great fanfare.
sentences.zh: 1977年1月17日，疾控中心的科学家们大张旗鼓地宣布了他们的发现。

sentences.en: I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 我当时太激动了。

sentences.en: This was such a spectacular, it was a great weight off my shoulders and a great discovery,
sentences.zh: 这太壮观了，这让我卸下了巨大的心理负担，这是一个伟大的发现，

sentences.en: a very, very special discovery.
sentences.zh: 一个非常、非常特别的发现。

sentences.en: They called the new bacteria Lesionella pneumophila.
sentences.zh: 他们将这种新细菌命名为嗜肺军团菌。

sentences.en: They had found the fatal bacteria.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了致命的细菌。

sentences.en: David Fraser and his colleagues went from being humiliated to congratulated.
sentences.zh: 大卫·弗雷泽和他的同事们从受辱变成了受贺。

sentences.en: But wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 但等一下。

sentences.en: Where had the bacteria come from?
sentences.zh: 这些细菌是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: This question wouldn't be answered until a couple years after the bacteria was discovered.
sentences.zh: 这个问题直到细菌被发现几年后才得到解答。

sentences.en: David Fraser retraces his steps around the outside of the Bellevue, nearly 40 years after
sentences.zh: 在疫情爆发近40年后，大卫·弗雷泽重走了一遍贝尔维尤酒店的外围。

sentences.en: the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 疫情爆发。

sentences.en: The Grand Hotel was restored and reopened in 1979.
sentences.zh: 这家大酒店在1979年修复并重新开放。

sentences.en: He points up to the very top of the building's roof.
sentences.zh: 他指着大楼屋顶的最顶端。

sentences.en: There are cooling towers, which would operate to eject heat from the hotel.
sentences.zh: 那里有冷却塔，用于排出酒店的热量。

sentences.en: Fraser explains that Lesionella bacteria occurs naturally in the environment, which can make
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽解释说，军团菌在环境中自然存在，这使得确定具体的源头

sentences.en: it hard to pin down a specific source.
sentences.zh: 变得很困难。

sentences.en: But it really likes to grow in warm water.
sentences.zh: 但它确实喜欢在温水中生长。

sentences.en: And one ideal environment is the warm water basins in air conditioning systeMs.
sentences.zh: 而一个理想的环境就是空调系统中的温水盆。

sentences.en: And when those systems convert warm water into cold air, they produce a mist as a byproduct.
sentences.zh: 当这些系统将温水转化为冷空气时，它们会产生一种雾气作为副产品。

sentences.en: And that mist can come across the edge of the roof and layer down the side of a building.
sentences.zh: 而这种雾气会飘过屋顶边缘，沿着建筑物侧面沉降。

sentences.en: It's one of the curious things about airflow in cities.
sentences.zh: 这是城市气流中奇特的现象之一。

sentences.en: If that mist carries Lesionella bacteria and is inhaled, it can make you sick.
sentences.zh: 如果这种雾气携带军团菌并被吸入，就会让你生病。

sentences.en: That's why people who were right outside the hotel and inside the front lobby were most
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么那些就在酒店外面和前厅里面的人最

sentences.en: likely to get infected.
sentences.zh: 容易被感染。

sentences.en: Fraser says contaminated mist from the Bellevue's cooling tower would have likely dropped down
sentences.zh: 弗雷泽说，来自贝尔维尤冷却塔的受污染雾气很可能落到了

sentences.en: the side of the hotel, exposing people on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 酒店侧面，使人行道上的人暴露在风险中。

sentences.en: And then?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: Here are some of these utility vents here.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些公用设施通风口。

sentences.en: It also would have been sucked into a vent near the ground that leads right into the front
sentences.zh: 它也可能被吸入靠近地面的通风口，直接通往

sentences.en: lobby, exposing people there.
sentences.zh: 前厅，使那里的人暴露在风险中。

sentences.en: The air conditioning system had always been a possible culprit as a breeding ground for
sentences.zh: 空调系统一直被怀疑是军团菌的滋生地。

sentences.en: the Lesionella bacteria.
sentences.zh: 军团菌。

sentences.en: But the CDC couldn't say for sure right away because the Bellevue-Stratford's cooling system
sentences.zh: 但疾控中心无法立即确定，因为贝尔维尤斯特拉特福德酒店的冷却系统

sentences.en: had been thoroughly cleaned following the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 在疫情爆发后已经彻底清洗过了。

sentences.en: By the time the CDC got there to get samples, there was no Lesionella bacteria present.
sentences.zh: 当疾控中心赶到那里取样时，已经没有军团菌存在了。

sentences.en: But as the years passed, there were more outbreaks of Lesionaires in other places.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，其他地方又出现了更多的军团病疫情。

sentences.en: And in those instances, they were able to confirm that the bacteria had come from the cooling
sentences.zh: 在这些案例中，他们得以证实细菌确实来自冷却

sentences.en: systeMs.
sentences.zh: 系统。

sentences.en: Researchers retroactively linked the bacteria to previously unsolved outbreaks, including
sentences.zh: 研究人员追溯性地将这种细菌与之前未解决的疫情联系起来，包括

sentences.en: a smaller one at the Bellevue a couple years before the 76th Legionnaire's Convention.
sentences.zh: 76年军团病大会前几年在贝尔维尤发生的一起较小的疫情。

sentences.en: In the public health community, the story of Legionnaire's disease has turned into a sort of poster
sentences.zh: 在公共卫生界，军团病的故事已经成为流行病学力量的某种

sentences.en: child for the power of epidemiology.
sentences.zh: 典范。

sentences.en: That shoe-leather detective work that's used to map out patterns and understand how diseases
sentences.zh: 那种用于绘制模式并了解疾病如何传播和侵袭的“鞋底侦探工作”。

sentences.en: move and strike.
sentences.zh: 移动并出击。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, the discovery of the disease didn't lead to its demise.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，这种疾病的发现并没有导致它的消亡。

sentences.en: The government now has recommendations for how to design and maintain cooling systems,
sentences.zh: 政府现在对如何设计和维护冷却系统有相关建议，

sentences.en: so they're not breeding grounds for Lesionella.
sentences.zh: 这样它们就不会成为军团菌的滋生地。

sentences.en: But even though the disease is treatable, there are still a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 但尽管这种疾病是可以治疗的，病例仍然很多。

sentences.en: In 2015, New York had an outbreak that was traced to an old opera house in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 2015年，纽约发生了一起疫情，追溯到布朗克斯区的一家老歌剧院。

sentences.en: Twelve people died, and more than 120 became sick.
sentences.zh: 12人死亡，超过120人患病。

sentences.en: As for the Bellevue Stratford, cleaning the cooling tower is now a routine part of the building's
sentences.zh: 至于贝尔维尤斯特拉特福德酒店，清洗冷却塔现在已成为该建筑维护的常规部分。

sentences.en: maintenance.
sentences.zh: 维护。

sentences.en: They also analyze water samples.
sentences.zh: 他们还会分析水样。

sentences.en: And during a major restoration in the 80s, the hotel got a completely new heating and
sentences.zh: 在80年代的一次重大修复中，酒店更换了全新的供暖和

sentences.en: cooling system.
sentences.zh: 制冷系统。

sentences.en: These days, business is good for the Grand Dame of Broad Street.
sentences.zh: 如今，这家“布罗德街的大贵妇”生意兴隆。

sentences.en: The hotel, now owned by Hyatt, has been modernized, but it still has that classic feel.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店现在由凯悦集团拥有，经过了现代化改造，但仍保留着那种经典的感觉。

sentences.en: Rooms run upwards of $500 a night and feature king-size beds, views of downtown Philly, 42-inch
sentences.zh: 客房每晚价格在500美元以上，配有特大号床、费城市中心景观、42英寸

sentences.en: flat-screen TVs, and of course, in the summertime, ice-cold air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 平板电视，当然，在夏天，还有冰爽的空调。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Alana Gordon, Delaney Hall, and Katie Mingle.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由Alana Gordon、Delaney Hall和Katie Mingle制作。

sentences.en: With Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, Kirk Kohlstedt, Sharif Youssef, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有Sam Greenspan、Avery Truffleman、Kirk Kohlstedt、Sharif Youssef，以及我，Roman Mars。

sentences.en: A version of this story originally aired on The Pulse from WHYY in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 这个故事的一个版本最初在费城WHYY的《The Pulse》节目中播出。

sentences.en: The Pulse covers stories at the heart of health, science, and innovation.
sentences.zh: 《The Pulse》报道健康、科学和创新领域的核心故事。

sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW的一个项目，在ArcSide的办公室制作，

sentences.zh: 这是加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心最宏伟的建筑和室内设计公司。

sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞这个节目。

sentences.en: You can follow us all on Twitter and Instagram, but the best way to explore the 99% invisible
sentences.zh: 你可以在Twitter和Instagram上关注我们，但探索塑造我们世界设计的99%隐形

sentences.en: activity that shapes the design of our world is to click around the hundreds of stories that
sentences.zh: 活动的最好方式，是点击浏览99pi.org上包含的数百个故事。

sentences.zh: 包含 99pi.org。
